senses.definition: n.m. 1 K 6:25 1. cut, shape; 2. extremity;—
ק׳ abs., shape of cherubim 1 K 6:25 (+ מִדָּה), of bases 7:37 (+ id.).
extremity, pl. cstr. קִצְבֵי הָרִים Jon 2:7 the extremities (bottoms) of (the) mountains (= קצבי הרים Ecclus 16:19).
